name: Jack Matlock
bio: Jack Matlock wrote to the Cow Boy in November 1885 from Lavina, Montana, where he drove on the Billings and Fort Benton stage line, and was still on that line in March 1886. By August 1886 he was driving for the National Park stage line.

Driving for the National Park stage line

mentions: Jack Matlock writes us from Lavina, Montana, where he is driving on the stage line between Billings and Fort Benton. He says that he has a forty-mile drive through a fine agricultura…
Jack Matlock and Charlie Jolly are driving on the Billings & Benton stage line and "Cold Turkey" Bill is in Billings.
A letter from Jack Matlock informs us that he is driving for the National Park stage line, that Wm. Tolbert is also there and that Chas. Jolly is on the Billings and Benton stage line.
